sloka: शीघ्रगः तु अग्निवर्णस्य शीघ्रगस्य मरुः सुतः ।मरोः प्रशुश्रुकः तु आसीत् अंबरीषः प्रशुश्रुकात् ॥१-७०-४१॥
transliteration: śīghragaḥ tu agnivarṇasya śīghragasya maruḥ sutaḥ ।maroḥ praśuśrukaḥ tu āsīt aṁbarīṣaḥ praśuśrukāt ॥1-70-41॥

translations.english: Sudarsana was the son of Samkhana. His son was Agnivarna. To Agnivarna was born Sighraga and to Sighraga, Maru. To Maru, was born Prasusruka and to Prasrusuka, Ambarisha.
